title_zh: 把出席人数预测标为待验证的估计

scenario.label_zh: 把出席人数预测标为待验证的估计
scenario.goal_zh: 指出线性模型不能直接支持给定概率，并约定说明样本有限、在后续活动检验预测

context_zh: 活动团队讨论只用三场历史活动数据建立的出席人数估计，不涉及真实投资或高风险决策。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Mira
sentences.text: Your mathematical model predicts eighty attendees from a hundred registrations. Can we put that in the planning note?

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: As a rough estimate, yes. It's a linear model fitted to just three past events.

sentences.speaker: Mira
sentences.text: What's the logic behind using registrations?

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: More registrations went with higher attendance in those events. But that pattern may not hold for a different kind of event.

sentences.speaker: Mira
sentences.text: Could we say there's a ninety percent likelihood that at least eighty people will come?

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: No. We haven't estimated that probability. The line gives a prediction, not that level of certainty.

sentences.speaker: Mira
sentences.text: Then I'll label eighty as a rough estimate based on three events, and we'll compare it with actual attendance afterwards.

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: Good. That makes the limitation visible instead of hiding it in the model.
